title: Conveyancing Legal Secretary
description:

Location: Caterham, Surrey
Job Type: Temporary (ongoing to cover sickness - Immediate Start available)
Hours: Full-Time, Monday to Friday, 9:30am - 5:30pm (Flexibly, reduced hours & part time would be considered as well)
Pay Rate: £15.00 - £20.00 per hour (Dependent on Experience)

The Opportunity

A well-established law firm in Caterham is seeking an experienced Residential Property / Conveyancing Legal Secretary to join their team on a temporary basis. Candidate Requirements
- Previous experience working as a Legal Secretary, Legal Assistant or Conveyancing Assistant within a Residential Property department.

- Experience with client onboarding, AML procedures, Land Registry applications, and SDLT submissions.
- Excellent audio typing and document production skills.
- Strong organisational and administrative abilities.
- Professional communication skills with a client-focused approach.
- Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment and manage competing priorities.
- Available to work full-time, Monday to Friday, 9:30am - 5:30pm.

What's on Offer?
